name: Princesscore
reacts_against: minimalist, neutral 'quiet luxury' dressing — princesscore is maximalist and unapologetically girlish.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Puff-sleeve dresses, corsets, tulle, lace, tiaras, ball gowns, pearls, opulent fabrics
wiki_facts.key_values: Elegance, romance, femininity, escapism, kindness, grace

findings: dark — about 44% of the measured color across 6 wiki images is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 74% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
